label: u/2/w after two of {f,0,b,l}, early in the original phase
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.017% of steps), active only in the original phase (87% of mass) and at the delimiter (13%), almost entirely at t=2..6 (peak t=3-4); never fires in the copy phase. It fires on a first-occurrence token when the two preceding inputs both come from {f,0,b,l} (about 75% of mass; prev2_tok=f has 15x lift). The strongest current tokens are u, 2 and w (u 9x lift, 2 7x), and the first token tends to be f/y/x/n/1. Top activations (0.19-0.20) are u or 2 right after contexts like f f 0, b f l, l f. Weaker activations (about 0.5x of max) show up on other new tokens (n, r, c, g, <DEL>) in the same kind of context. It almost never fires on repeated tokens (in_first=0 holds 3% of mass). The context alone is far from sufficient: {f,0,b,l}{f,0,b,l} followed by u/2/w is inactive in most cases, so the feature responds to a narrow hidden-state region that these token predicates only roughly approximate. Best predicate on dev: precision 0.37, recall 0.31.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev2_tok=f (+5.26), prev_tok=f (+5.06), phase=0 & in_tok=u (+3.73), prev3_tok=f (+3.38), orig0=y (+3.27), prev2_tok=l (+3.21). Lower it: phase=2 (-3.70).
